title: Capsicum: modeled ₹484/qtl left, Naraingarh → Thanesar
summary: January 2023: reported capsicum prices at Naraingarh and Thanesar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 87% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹484 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 314 same-variety market pairs screened for capsicum in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thanesar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Thanesar (Haryana) both reported capsicum prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,800 per quintal. Thanesar reported a median ₹2,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹700/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹700 per quintal, and Thanesar was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 74 km by road
scenes.caption: 74 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹16/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹455 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹325 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Thanesar report, the rule selects 21 of 23 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹484 per quintal (₹356 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Capsicum route from Naraingarh to Thanesar was positive on 87% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹48,400, or ₹35,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to capsicum
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Capsicum route from Naraingarh to Thanesar was positive on 87% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹48,400, or ₹35,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
